# Buddha Meditation Center of Greater Washington DC

Meditation for anyone, regardless of background.

- Site: https://buddhameditationdc.org
- Also known as: Mahamevnawa Meditation Center
- Address: 5004 Stone Rd, Rockville, MD 20853, USA
- Email: info@buddhameditationdc.org
- Phone: +1 762 233 3390

## What this place is

A volunteer-run Theravada monastery offering mindfulness and meditation to the public. First-time visitors are treated as people seeking calm, not as converts. Deeper Buddhist study is available for those who ask.
